name: Zinge's Assessment
label: Quest
description: Zinge's Assessment: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is unexpected. It looks like Fenstad might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in mind control potions.
It isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of this, but a few of the ingredients I detected... This is serious alchemy, along the abilities of a member of the Royal Apothecary Society.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, I was right. We must waste no time. We must determine the source of these tainted fragrances.
Here, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.
